intended_object: The integral power basis of the ring of integers 𝓞 K over ℤ generated by ζ − 1, where K is the p^k-th cyclotomic field over ℚ and ζ is a primitive p^k-th root of unity; that is, 𝓞 K = ℤ[ζ − 1]. Inferred from the docstring.
explanation: The body applies PowerBasis.ofAdjoinEqTop' to the integral element ζ − 1 of 𝓞 K. The fact that it generates all of 𝓞 K comes from the existing power basis integralPowerBasisOfPrimePow with generator ζ, together with ζ = (ζ − 1) + 1. The result is a ℤ-power basis of 𝓞 K whose generator is ζ − 1, exactly the intended object. The prime-power cyclotomic setting is the one where this result is standard and the one the construction relies on (the prime-power result 𝓞 K = ℤ[ζ]), so the definition is not too narrow.
